nodes.name: CoFe LDHs co-precipitation
nodes.procedure: Metal salts of a mole ratio (Co/Fe = 2:1) with a total amount of 6 mmol, typically, Co(NO₃)₂·6H₂O (4 mmol) and Fe(NO₃)₃·9H₂O (2 mmol) were dissolved in 50 mL deionized water by sonication for 30 min. Then, NH₄F (15 mmol) was added and further magnetically stirred for another 30 min. Simultaneously, 50 mL aqueous solution containing NaOH (21 mmol) and Na₂CO₃ (3 mmol) was prepared. The second solution was added drop by drop to the first solution under rapid magnetic stirring until pH=9.5. The mixture was stirred for 5 h, then aged at room temperature for 12 h. The precipitate was centrifuged, washed 4 times with water/ethanol, and dried at 70°C overnight.

nodes.name: Cu atomic loading on CoFe LDHs
nodes.procedure: A certain amount of CuCl2·2H2O was dissolved into 40 mL aqueous solution containing NaOH (0.01 M) and stirred until a homogeneous solution was formed. Subsequently, a calculated amount of the as-prepared pure CoFe LDHs sample was added to the solution under vigorous stirring at room temperature for 15 h. The final precipitate was centrifuged and washed with deionized water and ethanol three times. Finally, the product was dried under atmospheric pressure in an electric oven at 70°C for 18 h.

nodes.characterization_summary: All Cu/CoFe LDHs samples show hydrotalcite-like LDH structure with rhombohedral R3m symmetry; Cu4.76/CoFe LDHs exhibits best crystallinity with crystallite size 30.375 nm and no Cu species peaks indicating atomic dispersion.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 1 shows the X-ray diffraction (XRD) diagrams of the five samples which corresponded to well-crystallized hydrotalcite-like compounds with rhombohedral trigonal structure and R 3 m symmetry.

nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 2 shows the FTIR spectra of the CoFe LDHs samples before and after atomic Cu loading.

nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 3, the low and high magnifications FESEM micrographs ... 2D layered nanoplate-like curved edges nanosheets ... forming 3D hierarchical porous flowerlike morphologies.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS survey confirms Cu, Co, Fe, O, C presence in Cu4.76/CoFe LDHs; Co 2p shows Co²⁺ (783.92/799.35 eV) and Co³⁺ (781.13/797.07 eV); Fe 2p shows Fe²⁺ (711.43/720.43 eV) and Fe³⁺ (714.18/723.93 eV); Cu 2p shows Cu(I) at 929.8 eV confirmed by Cu LMM kinetic energy 917.32 eV (Cu₂O), Cu(II) at 933.8/937.84 eV; positive shifts in Co/Fe binding energies after Cu loading indicate electronic coupling.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figures S5, the XPS survey spectrum ... contains Co, Fe, Cu, O and C elements, confirming that the atomic Cu species were successfully loaded ... The distinctive Cu LMM peak appeared at a kinetic energy of 917.32 eV evidencing the presence of Cu(I) species of Cu₂O.
